+    def get_min_area_info(pts, n):
+        min_a = 1e18
+        best_tri = (0, 1, 2)
+        for i in range(n):
+            x1, y1 = pts[i]
+            for j in range(i + 1, n):
+                x2, y2 = pts[j]
+                dx21 = x2 - x1
+                dy21 = y2 - y1
+                for k in range(j + 1, n):
+                    x3, y3 = pts[k]
+                    a = abs(dx21 * (y3 - y1) - (x3 - x1) * dy21)
+                    if a < min_a:
+                        min_a = a
+                        best_tri = (i, j, k)
+        return 0.5 * min_a, best_tri
+
+    grid_points = [[i / 3.0, j / 3.0] for i in range(4) for j in range(4)]
